name: czrecoilframe_set_menu_bar_visibility
description: CZRecoilFrame::SetMenuBarVisibility toggles the frame style and attaches or removes the main menu handle.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x430680 yet; the function currently has functional evidence only.
The native smoke creates a Win32 window and menu, exercises hidden and visible paths, and verifies WS_SYSMENU and GetMenu state.
